hypothesis: Ridge readout fitted on identities 0..8 will preserve source-family paired-order ranking on independently unseen identities 9..17; if evidence is memorized entity identity instead of temporal relational structure, entity-out transfer loses >=0.05 accuracy.
lineage: Pinned W-R59 source and W-R54 family-balanced ridge; new dev and heldout populations, no amplitude outside native support.
score: Use original W-R59 two-candidate ridge margin and balanced signed-credit score. For every independent training block, source, amplitude and heldout seed, evaluate seen and unseen identities on identical generator and site, retaining complete per-seed/group aggregate outcomes.
primary: ENTITY_GENERALIZATION if every xorshift unseen cohort score >=0.55 and any model's unseen xorshift score falls no more than 0.05 versus seen, over all 3 blocks x 3 amplitudes. PARTIAL_ENTITY_TRANSFER if at least 5 of 9 xorshift cases >=0.55 and average new-entity minus seen score >=-0.10; NO_ENTITY_TRANSFER otherwise. These are distinct from cross-family generalization.
controls: No extra train or hyperparameter tuning from heldout; original W-R59 training corpus and feature protocol unchanged except preregistered new development seed identities
Evaluate all three source families and three supported amplitude settings with paired equivalent observation encoding check
Identities 9..17 never provided to ridge_fit development
One original first-use only, capture all null/negative evidence, independent qualification; accepted refs and FORGE untouched
claim_limit: Synthetic equal-width paired-choice entity-identity transfer, not broad cognition, temporal semantics or deployable RSI.
